title: Fix the midterms carousel renderer for the real words
goal: The renderer from ve-carousel-midterms-1 (.scratch/carousel/midterms/draw.py, same worktree) fails on the session's real words in .scratch/carousel/midterms/words.json, which are full sentence-case sentences of 11 to 19 words, longer than the sample. Do not change words.json. Rework draw.py so every card passes on those words: the cover headline at least 1.3 times the body headline size and different from the body cards in at least two of scale, headline position and share of picture (keep the scoreboard night scene full-bleed, headline big over the lower field); body headline and line type at least 35 px of ink, wrapped to fit, never shrunk below that; every line centred within 24 px; nothing outside 80 px of any edge (card 4's line currently overruns the bottom); keep the board at least 12% of each card. Keep the look: the stadium scoreboard with lamp digits, brand colours and fonts only.
contract: Edit only draw.py; outputs out/card-1.png to card-6.png at 1080x1350 from words.json. Colours and fonts only from config/ve/brand-tokens.json and the Brand section; no system font; no logos, clipart people, card numbers, footnotes or URLs except the close CTA; the mark is the official file.
